title: feat(app-shell): 消息中心重复通知分组/去重/折叠 (#2765)
body:
## Problem

Fixes #2765. The message center listed every notification individually with no grouping — in the showcase, `showcase_scheduled_digest` (interval trigger, ~1/min) filled the inbox with 10+ identical "Scheduled project digest" rows within minutes and pinned the bell badge at `9+`. The demo cadence only makes the gap loud: any real workspace with a recurring notification (digests, monitors, SLA nudges) hits the same wall, so the durable fix is frontend grouping, not demo-data tuning (the 60s interval is deliberately DEMO-ONLY per its own comment; left untouched per the issue's "optional separate track" framing).

## Changes

- **`inboxGrouping.ts` (new, pure)** — coalesces a newest-first notification list into `(topic, title)` groups: NUL-composite key so distinct pairs never collide; rows with neither topic nor title stand alone instead of collapsing into a catch-all bucket; per-group unread count and newest timestamp. Exported types re-exported from `InboxPopover` for back-compat.
- **`InboxPopover`** — a group of many renders as one expandable row titled with a `×N` count pill (chevron, newest timestamp, "{n} unread" line) that expands to its members; a group of one stays a plain row. Per-group **"mark read"** button marks all of that type read. Collapsed by default.
- **Badge semantics** — the bell + Notifications tab badge now count **distinct unread topics** + pending approvals instead of raw rows: 10 identical digests + 2 mentions read as `3`, not `9+`.
- **`AppHeader`** — new `markManyRead` marks a whole group read in a **single** `POST /api/v1/notifications/read` (batched event ids), optimistic like the existing single/all paths; wired via the new optional `onMarkManyRead` prop (component falls back to N single calls when unwired).
- **i18n** — `notifications.groupCount` / `groupUnread` / `groupMarkRead` / `groupMarkReadTitle` in `en` + `zh`; other locales fall back to the English `defaultValue` (nested-key parity is not enforced by the locale tests).

## Verification

- `vitest --project unit inboxGrouping` — 6 new tests covering coalescing, first-seen order, unread counting, topic-collision safety, no-catch-all fallback, empty list ✓
- `packages/i18n` i18n.test.ts (locale parity) ✓ — 48 tests total across both suites
- `tsc --noEmit` in `@object-ui/app-shell` ✓ (post-refactor)
- `eslint` clean on all touched files (the `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning was avoided by keeping the pure helper in its own module)
